put.summary: Put an organization on a contract
put.description: From now (ADR 0045). `invoiced` bills it monthly: usage its credit does not cover, the platform fee (prorated in a part month) and any top-up to the minimum commitment go on one Stripe invoice, due `terms_days` after it is sent; ingestion is suspended `overdue_grace_days` after a missed due date, or at once when what it owes, billed or not, reaches `credit_limit_micros`. It needs a credit limit and a billing email, and no live subscription. `prepaid` moves it back, closing what is unbilled on a final invoice. Terms are never edited: each call is a new contract. Recorded in the organization's audit log.
